title: Sodium hypochlorite oxidation of imazalil: mechanistic insights and byproduct profiling
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EW00025H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Armando Zarrelli
This study elucidates the degradation of the fungicide imazalil during hypochlorite disinfection, identifying eleven transformation byproducts and proposing mechanistic pathways with implications for water treatment safety.
